name: Lloyds Steels Industries Limited
summary: Lloyds Steels Industries Limited provides engineering products and services in India. It designs, engineers, manufactures, fabricates, supplies, erects, and commissions mechanical, hydraulic, structural, process plants, metallurgical, and chemical plants equipment, including marine loading/unloading arms, truck/wagon loading/unloading arms, columns, pressure vessels, dryers, boilers, power plant, and steel plant and capital equipment. The company also executes turnkey and EPC projects. Lloyds Steels Industries Limited was founded in 1974 and is based in Mumbai, India.
